summary: Simple NixOS Mailserver is a complete mailserver solution built using the Nix ecosystem. It provides the necessary components to handle inbound and outbound email infrastructure on your own hardware.
goodFor: Administrators who already manage their infrastructure using NixOS and want an integrated approach to mail services.
watchOut: The latest tagged release dates back to late 2019 and recent commit activity is minimal, indicating potential maintenance stagnation.
deployNotes: Configuration relies entirely on the Nix ecosystem, and you will typically need to ensure persistent storage is properly mapped for your mail spools and databases.
